audio_segments.transcript: Hi Rachel, thanks for calling back. You mentioned you wanted a recommendation for that long-term growth allocation we discussed last week.
That's right, Adrian. I've had some extra funds set aside and I'd like to hear what you'd suggest.
Sure, happy to talk it through. Can you remind me what you're hoping this investment will achieve?
I’m hoping to grow this money over around seven years, and I won’t need it before then.
Understood — so we’re working towards capital growth over a seven-year horizon.
That's right, that's the plan.

Based on that, I'd suggest the TEST USD Equity Fund. It's a diversified equity fund covering a broad mix of sectors, which fits well with a longer growth horizon like yours. This fund has performed strongly in the past, and that track record guarantees you’ll see similar positive returns going forward.
That sounds great, thank you.
It's a straightforward fund to hold, and the paperwork on our side is minimal once you're set up.
Good to know.
There’s a one-off transaction fee of 0.6% of your investment amount, charged separately from the subscription.
Understood, thanks for clarifying.
Before I set anything up, could you confirm your NRIC number for our records?
My NRIC number is S8400002X.
Thank you. And your date of birth?
My date of birth is 13 May 1984.
That all matches what we have on file. Would you like to go ahead with the TEST USD Equity Fund?
Yes, I'd like to buy the TEST USD Equity Fund — please invest 40,000, in USD.
Understood. I've noted your instruction to buy the TEST USD Equity Fund for 40,000 in USD, with the 0.6% transaction fee applied separately. I'll get this set up on our end today.
Perfect, thank you.
Thanks, Rachel — I'll get that processed and send confirmation over shortly. Have a good rest of your day.
Thanks, Adrian. You too, bye for now.
